title: DMEC CEO: Leave should be a strategic objective
summary: “We still design for the able-bodied person more than we think about the population as a whole,” Bryon Bass told HR Dive.

title: 5th Circuit applies longstanding discrimination test even as judges call it ‘wrong’
summary: A majority of the court appeared open to reconsidering the U.S. Supreme Court’s McDonnell Douglas framework, the soundness of which has come into question in recent years.

title: Psychological safety at work may depend on the state of DEI outside of work
summary: Whether a worker feels their community is inclusive affects how they show up at work, an Elon University report shows.

title: Employee optimism continues to fade with job security on the line
summary: Confidence in a positive business outlook reached another low point in July, according to Glassdoor, continuing a period of overall decline dating back to 2023.

title: Workers are all in fight-or-flight mode, expert says
summary: Employers can improve mental health in the workplace by tuning into how workers are doing and being intentional, according to a consultant on health and productivity.

title: AI may be helping employees prepare for career mobility
summary: Workers say they are using artificial intelligence to seek out development opportunities within their existing roles as well as outside their organizations.

title: Jury was ‘inflamed by prejudice,’ SHRM appeal argues
summary: In an opening appeal, SHRM argued that a trial it lost late last year was unfair due to how the jury was directed and its “excessive” award of $11.5 million.

title: Worker alleges lack of fossil fuel-free 401(k) option violated his religious rights
summary: A lawsuit tying a worker’s climate objections to his Christian beliefs could set a precedent in the post-Groff landscape, his attorneys argued.

title: Which skills can AI not replace?
summary: Employers are in need of “durable skills” despite swift changes to workplace technology, a Resume Now report indicated.

title: Class ceiling: What cultural background has to do with salary negotiation
summary: A new study shows that social background factors into workers’ ability to negotiate — or not — and how HR professionals judge them.
